name: JV_OVERHEAD_METHODS_F_B_
description: This table contains the date effective overhead methods for each joint venture. These methods are used to calculate and generate overhead transactions to charge indirect costs to the joint venture partners.

columns.name: OVERHEAD_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture overhead method.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture that the overhead method is associated to.

columns.name: METHOD_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The short name of the joint venture overhead method that is used as an identifier across effective dates for the joint venture.

columns.name: METHOD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of overhead method used to determine how to calculate the overhead amount. It is based on the ORA_JV_OVERHEAD_METHOD_TYPE lookup codes such as percentage of cost.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: BASIS_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: The source that the overhead calculation is based on. It is based on the ORA_JV_OVERHEAD_SOURCE lookup codes such as billed joint venture transactions.

columns.name: METHOD_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: The percentage in the overhead method that is used to calculate the overhead amount.

columns.name: FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: The fixed amount applied to the joint venture as overhead.

columns.name: METHOD_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the joint venture overhead method. It is based on the ORA_JV_OVERHEAD_METHOD_STATUS lookup codes such as pending, active, inactive, or other user defined values.

columns.name: STRUCTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the structure associated with the account segment assigned to the overhead method. This is used to get the account name and segment value description.

columns.name: SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Identifies which segment in the chart of accounts is used to select joint venture transactions for overhead calculations.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Identifies the segment value used to select joint venture transactions for overhead calculations.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_PERCENT_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The ownership definition short name to be used when splitting the calculated overhead amount for distribution to the stakeholders.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The distribution type that is passed into the joint venture invoice for the distributed overhead transactions to be used for account mapping to assign the receivable offset account to the invoice line. It is based on the ORA_JV_METHOD_DIST_TYPE lookup codes such as overhead or fees.

columns.name: MINIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: The minimum debit amount for an overhead accounts receivable line. This amount will be used instead of the calculated overhead debit amount if the calculated amount is less than the minimum. If the calculated overhead amount results in a credit, this amount is ignored.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: The source of the transaction date in a transaction with the calculated overhead amount. It is based on the ORA_JV_TRANSACTION_DATE_SOURCE lookup codes such as last day of the period or system date.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield combination defining column that will be used as the receivable offset account in invoicing.

columns.name: PERIOD_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Determines how the overhead calculation basis is derived. It is based on the ORA_JV_OVERHEAD_PERIOD lookup codes such as period, year to period, or inception to period.

columns.name: CALENDAR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of calendar being used when calculating overhead. It is based on the ORA_JV_CALENDAR_TYPE lookup codes such as standard or fiscal.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: The maximum overhead amount allowed to be billed.

columns.name: SOURCE_ACCOUNT_SET_ID
columns.description: The account set used to select GL and SLA transactions for the overhead calculation.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: The account used to select GL and SLA transactions for the overhead calculation.

columns.name: SOURCE_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: The ledger used to select GL and SLA transactions for the overhead calculation.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder that is to be directly billed for the transaction. This can be overridden from what was originally assigned.

columns.name: SLIDING_SCALE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the overhead method will use a sliding scale.

columns.name: METHOD_RATE
columns.description: The rate in the overhead method that is used to calculate the overhead amount.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the periodic adjustment factor that the overhead method is associated with.

columns.name: LAST_ADJUSTMENT_DATE
columns.description: The date that the overhead method was last adjusted.

columns.name: LAST_FACTOR_VALUE_DATE
columns.description: The date of the last adjustment factor value used to adjust the overhead method.

columns.name: LAST_FACTOR_VALUE_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: The percentage of the last adjustment factor value used to adjust the overhead method.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
